title: Hosting a 3 days Game Jam with No Rules!
author: Virtualeaf
selftext:
Hey everyone, I've been looking to join a game jam but everyone bans any use of AI. 

So i thought fuck it, I'm hosting one myself without any rules. So here goes!  
  
on Feb 26 - Sunday 1 March we run a 3 day Jam:  
  
\- Use AI   
\- Use templates  
\- Use any engine  
\- PC, Mac, Web, Console  
\- Be a big team  
\- Be a solo dev  
  
Only thing that matters   
  
Make the most fun game in 1 weekend to win!   
  
Join the world quest below!   
  
[https://www.summerengine.com/jam](https://www.summerengine.com/jam)

https://preview.redd.it/c4qa0fgdtoig1.png?width=3402&format=png&auto=webp&s=a7a85bdc61e5175ae3be1592f2bef93edba316a3

replies.author: Virtualeaf
replies.body: can you try again u/Narrow-Impress-2238 ? i just pushed an update

replies.author: Virtualeaf
replies.body: it’s fixed now and you can join :)

replies.author: Turbulent-Stretch881
replies.body: If you're hosting this and it failed at the first/most important step I'd say it doesn't bode well..

replies.author: Virtualeaf
replies.body: well all I’m hosting is a group where people can get together and show off their work, and will give a reward to the winner :) I want to see more games, and just moved fast and put up this page in a few minutes to see if people wanted to join. And they do! i think it will be awesome:)

comments.body: You said no rules I’m doing to take 3 months !! Jokes aside hope the event goes well !

comments.author: Virtualeaf

comments.author: erebusman
comments.body: You should cross post this on [itch.io](http://itch.io) [https://itch.io/jams](https://itch.io/jams) you'll get even more folks.

replies.body: that's a great idea, thanks! I'll post there now:)

comments.author: night__day
comments.body: Quick question, if we want to use summer engine, will you be giving some kind of pass for higher usage rates?  Like pro for the weekend?

replies.author: Virtualeaf
replies.body:
yeah I'm planning on it! a few days prior to the event I'll let you know in our Discord (as we don't have any investors, I can't promise X free usage, in case a lot of people join haha!) 

But yep i'm definitely planning on it!

replies.author: Virtualeaf
replies.body:
How about I give the first 10 people who sign up for the Jam and choosing 'Summer Engine' as their engine choice, pro access for the weekend :)

\- possibly more, but i'll see how many signs up!

replies.author: night__day
replies.body: Sure, I signed up, I'm not really a pro dev or anything, so I doubt I will be burning through your usage as some others might, I'm just joining to push myself to try and make something for the weekend, thanks :)

replies.author: Virtualeaf
replies.body: it’s going to be super fun! can’t wait!
